QuestInfo.name: Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery Opening
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann has something he wants to show you.
QuestInfo.1: You've been invited to the grand opening of Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery. It's going to be an artsplosion of epic artportions!
QuestInfo.2: You arrived at Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery.

0.0: #h0#, I know you're busy doing the hunting and the exploring, but you should really take a break! You need to savor the beauty of the world. YOU need to come down... to Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery!!

yes.0: Just step into the nearest Dimensional Mirror to find yourself in the mystical, magical world of Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery!  Wash your dried up soul in a downpour of my creative juices!

1.0: Welcome one and all to the grand opening of the world's latest and greatest gallery of the bizarre and the profound! Take it in, folks!
